title: Resurrection Observation and Inference Sheet
purpose: Support the primary activity for The Resurrection Changes the Story.
body_markdown:
# Resurrection Observation and Inference Sheet

Use Luke 24:1-12, 36-49 as your evidence.

1. Write or draw three direct observations.
2. Mark one interpretation or conclusion.
3. Name one careful response.
4. Put a question mark beside anything the passage does not settle by itself.
